# teebe

> teebe is a free, open-source, native macOS GUI for managing git worktrees. It shows every worktree of every repo in one window, updates the file tree live as files change on disk, and previews diffs inline. It is built for developers running AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI) in parallel, one worktree per agent session. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon and Intel, auto-updates via Sparkle.

Key facts:

- teebe is a worktree-aware file browser and mission control, not a full git client (no rebase, cherry-pick, or merge-conflict UI) and not a code editor; files open in the user's own apps.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://teebe.io/install.sh | bash`, or download from GitHub Releases.
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later, with a commercial license available. Source: https://github.com/klein-t/teebe
- Privacy: no in-app telemetry; download counts only, no IPs stored.

## Pages

- [Home](https://teebe.io/): what teebe does, feature overview, interactive demo, FAQ
- [Guide: Claude Code worktrees, explained](https://teebe.io/guides/claude-code-worktrees/): how `claude --worktree` works, where worktrees live (.claude/worktrees), .worktreeinclude, subagent isolation, cleanup, and how to see what each parallel session changed
- [Guide: Codex worktrees](https://teebe.io/guides/codex-worktrees/): how the Codex app isolates parallel chats in worktrees under $CODEX_HOME/worktrees, managed vs permanent worktrees, cleanup limits
- [Guide: Cursor worktrees and parallel agents](https://teebe.io/guides/cursor-worktrees/): how Cursor's parallel agents use worktrees, .cursor/worktrees.json setup, /apply-worktree, cleanup settings
- [Guide: Claude Code diff viewer](https://teebe.io/guides/view-claude-code-changes/): using teebe to watch a Claude Code session's edits in real time, with inline diffs
- [Guide: Claude Code desktop vs terminal vs VS Code](https://teebe.io/guides/claude-code-desktop-vs-terminal/): which Claude Code surface fits which workflow
- [Guide: git worktree vs branch](https://teebe.io/guides/git-worktree-vs-branch/): what each is, worktree vs clone vs stash, decision table
- [Guide: git worktree cheat sheet](https://teebe.io/guides/git-worktree-cheat-sheet/): add, list, remove, prune, move, lock, and common error fixes
- [Comparison: every git worktree GUI for Mac](https://teebe.io/compare/git-worktree-gui-mac/): Fork, Tower, GitKraken, Sourcetree, Conductor, Nimbalyst, Worktrunk, Grovr, WorktreeWise, and teebe compared on worktree features, price, and AI-agent support
- [Changelog](https://teebe.io/changelog.html): release history
- [Privacy](https://teebe.io/privacy.html): data practices
